entries.title: Findings Email Prompt Rewrite & Letter Generation Improvements
entries.summary: Findings email generation uses a rewritten V2 prompt with combined law+application format, improved critic review, duplicate heading fix, and automatic retry on network errors.
highlights: Findings email prompt rewritten (V2) with combined law+application format for stronger legal reasoning and clarity.
Prompt quality improvements: reasoning depth examples, evidentiary gap communication, concision rules, and consolidated anti-repetition guidance.
Fixed duplicate "Key Legal Issues" heading that could appear near the end of some findings emails.
Polisher now preserves "You report that..." attribution in Background & Issue instead of stripping it.
"Key Provisions" heading removed from critic prompt and polisher for cleaner output.
Letter generation and analysis now auto-retry on network errors to prevent lost work.
Local OCR fallback when remote OCR returns 500 errors.

entries.title: Documentation & Help Section Update
entries.summary: Help documentation updated to reflect current UI, workflows, and features including Settings page documentation.
highlights: Clio connection instructions updated to reflect navigation bar modal workflow.
Results workspace tab names corrected: Case Analysis, Gaps, Full Analysis, Document Review, Findings & Demand, Case Chat, Quality Report.
Settings page fully documented: contact info, jurisdiction, AI model preferences, document blacklist, and analysis processing.
Recommendation letter types documented: proceed, declination, settlement advisory, request for documents.
AI model references updated to current models (GPT-5.2, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-5 Nano, GPT-4o).

entries.title: Gap Resolution Workflow + Signature Reconciliation Hardening
entries.summary: Gap resolution now supports targeted refreshes and improved signed-document reconciliation, including opaque/UUID filenames.
highlights: Per-gap resolution text is entered inside each expanded gap card, with optional related-document references.
Selective gap refresh now validates cache state against case document changes to reduce stale gap results.
Signed document reconciliation now uses document content hints (not only filenames), reducing false "missing executed agreement" flags.
Signature evidence and reconciliation notes are surfaced directly in gap analysis results.

entries.title: Case Page Results Workspace Persistence
entries.summary: The results workspace is retained while moving between case tabs to reduce context loss and improve responsiveness.
highlights: Results stay mounted in the background when switching away from Analysis and back.
Re-entry to Analysis is faster and does not require re-opening the workspace.
Analysis view state is synchronized to URL parameters for clearer navigation continuity.

entries.title: Unified Case + Results Navigation
entries.summary: Case analysis and results workflows are now more tightly integrated from the case page.
highlights: Results workspace is available inline within the case experience.
Users can move from analysis controls into results without leaving case context.
Reduced workflow choppiness between document management and analysis outputs.

entries.title: Clio Sync Enhancements
entries.summary: Clio integration reliability and scale were expanded to support heavier real-world matters.
highlights: Two-way sync improvements with stronger change detection and re-analysis signaling.
Pagination limits removed for full-matter imports.
Sync feedback and error handling expanded for operational clarity.

entries.title: Document Processing and Vision Pipeline Improvements
entries.summary: Document extraction now handles mixed-quality inputs more consistently, with better fallback behavior.
highlights: Expanded OCR/Vision fallback logic for low-quality and image-heavy documents.
Improved extraction status visibility and retry workflows in verification tooling.
Stronger handling of extraction failures so analysis can proceed with clear warnings.
